newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Lim Kim holder may sell stake.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Lim Kim holder may sell stake.

text.p: Malaysia's Lim Kim Hai Holdings (M) Bhd said a substantial shareholder is in talks to sell a "substantial stake" in the company.
The statement, which was sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Thursday, did not provide details. Officials of the company were not available for comment.
"The negotiations have, however, not been concluded," the distributor of electrical components and equipment said.
Its shares have been suspended and closed at 18 ringgit on November 1. In the statement on Thursday, Lim Kim asked the stock exchange to resume trading in its stock.
